name: Life in a New City
source:
Life in a New City has you, the protagonist, move to a new city and explore relationships with different characters. Converse with the local girls and attempt to forge a strong bond with one or many.

A slice of life visual novel with minigames that will test your social skills. Who will you choose to spend the most time with?

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3931840/]Steam[/url]]
